title: New #611 tests re-inline the detail+route model scaffolding instead of the existing refcheck_detail_model helper
detail: Project rule: extract helpers when logic repeats 2+ places. Both new tests duplicate the helper's model construction; test 2 also duplicates the rc-1 Objected call block for the reorder.
recommended_fix: Build models via model.Model(..refcheck_detail_model([call]), refcheck_expanded:, refcheck_edit:, ...); bind the rc-1 Objected call once and reuse it in `reordered`.

title: No single test executes the issue's full stale-save sequence (type → reordered refetch → Save)
location: client/test/client_test.gleam:6952-6962 (test 2 tail, no save click) vs client/test/client_test.gleam:6838 (test 1 save, no refetch)
detail: The two tests pin each half independently (save reads the typed dict entry; refetch preserves it), but the composed harm sequence — reorder, then Save persists the NEW value — is never executed in one test.
recommended_fix: Extend test 2 after the refetch: type a name too, click the save button, assert saving:True with the typed values in the same dict entry.
